senses.gloss: blossom, flower, an ornament in the shape of a flower.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="K01067"><he>כַּפְתּוֹר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:7">Kel. XI, 7</cite> <he>הפ׳ והבסיס</he> the calyx of a candlestick and the shaft.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:7">Esth. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>אני ישנתי על פִּרְחוֹ של וכ׳</he> I slept on the flower (capital) of one of those columns, and there was room for a body at full length, with outstretched hands and feet.
<cite ref="Menachot 28b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>פְּרָחֶיהָ … כמין פִּרְחֵי וכ׳</he> what did the flowers of the candlestick look like? Like the blossoms on the capitals of columns; a. e.

senses.gloss: פ׳ לבן White Blossom, name of an aromatic shrub.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 6:2">Deut. R. s. 6</cite>, beg. <he>פ׳ לבן הוא שכרו וכ׳</he> this is a White Blossom, the wages for working at it are half a goldpiece.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 7:1:3">Y. Shebi. VII, beg. 37ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 5:7">Tosef. ib. V, 7</cite> <he>פ׳ לבין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="Q01759"><he>פרחבלין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01759"><he>פרחבינ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01759"><he>פרחביל׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:8">Midd. I, 8</cite>, a. fr. <he>פִּרְחֵי כהונה</he>, v. <cite ref="K00152"><he>כְּהוּנָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 59b">Keth. 59ᵇ</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>אפרוחים</he>). Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵈ top (expl. <he>סכות בנות</he>, <cite ref="II Kings 17:30">II Kings XVII, 30</cite>) <he>תרנגולתא ופְרָחֶיהָ</he> a hen with her chickens.
